facts.fact: AMI reports that the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Modernisation of the Administration 'a annoncé le début de la préparation' of the Agenda National de la Transformation Numérique 2030 at a one-day workshop in Nouakchott on 4 December 2025; the article names no adopting act.
facts.system: Agenda National de la Transformation Numérique 2030

facts.fact: On 4 December 2025 the digital ministry opened the preparation of the Agenda National de la Transformation Numérique 2030, with the World Bank taking part by video link, at a workshop that also evaluated the 2022-2025 agenda.
facts.system: Agenda National de la Transformation Numérique 2030

facts.fact: At the 4 December 2025 workshop evaluating the 2022-2025 agenda, the ministry's secretary general said it brought considerable advances in digital infrastructure, electronic platforms and access to public services; the article gives no figures against the agenda's targets.
facts.system: Agenda National de la Transformation Numérique 2022-2025
